description: Convert a size between systems so the shopper orders the right one: women's clothing (letter, US, UK, EU, FR, IT, DE), men's tailoring (letter, US, UK, EU, IT), women's and men's shoes (EU, US, UK, European luxury convention), athletic sneakers (US_M, US_W, UK, EU, CM), rings (US, UK, EU, millimetres) and jeans waist. Use it whenever the shopper's size and the item's sizes are in different systems, before recommending a size. Returns every equivalent, a note on the convention used, and 'approximate' or 'ambiguous' when the size is between or spans rows. The brand's own chart always wins. No key needed; read-only.

size.description: The size as printed, e.g. '38', 'M', '7.5', 'L' (UK ring), '28' (jeans waist).

system.description: The system the size is in, e.g. EU, US, UK, IT, FR, letter, US_W, US_M, waist_in.

name: convert_size
title: Convert a size
